_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game's files: disk images (.d64, .g64, .x64, .d71, .d81), tape images (.t64, .tap), a cartridge (.crt) or a program (.prg, .p00). The first is the one autostarted; the others wait their turn in drive 8, for the games that ask for another disk (Previous Disk, Next Disk, Eject Disk). Your files are never changed: the C64 writes to copies of them in its memory, and Export Save Data writes out the ones it changed.
